text.title: Incident Decision Template — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the 2-minute incident decision record: the incident trigger with the time the call was spoken and the time the record was committed, the commander as owner, named `inputs[]` entries for options_considered (at least two, one of them do-nothing), blast_radius (with a number), rollback_trigger (metric, threshold, window, rollback command), optional executor and reconstructed, a one-sentence imperative decision, pinned evidence URLs, and a review dated no later than the postmortem. Validator in scripts/validate-incident-decision-template.py enforces it, including the 2-minute window.

required.field: `kind` = `incident`, `url` of the incident ticket or channel, `incident_id`, `decided_at` and `committed_at` as ISO-8601 timestamps, `bridge_open_at_commit` (r-record-before-bridge-closes)
the incident commander or the recorded delegate, `role:handle` (r-owner-is-commander-or-delegate)

named entries: `options_considered` (array of at least 2 one-line options, one containing "do nothing" or "keep observing"), `blast_radius` (string with a number and a named system, region or tenant), `rollback_trigger` (object: `metric`, `threshold`, `window`, `rollback`); optional `executor` (`role:handle`) and `reconstructed` (`true` plus `at`) (r-options-considered-min-two, r-blast-radius-quantified, r-rollback-trigger-measurable)
one imperative sentence: action, target system, when; no "consider", "maybe", "look into", "should probably" (r-decision-is-one-imperative-sentence)

at least one URL; dashboard links carry a pinned time range (`from=`/`to=`, `start=`/`end=`, `time=`/`time.window=`); alert, log-query, chat-permalink and commit URLs allowed; documentation pages are not evidence (r-evidence-is-timestamped-signal)
`postmortem_date`, `next_review_at` no later than it, `outcome` filled at the postmortem with `rollback_trigger_fired` and `blast_radius_matched` (r-review-at-postmortem)

forbidden.pattern: `committed_at` more than 2 minutes after `decided_at`, or `bridge_open_at_commit: false`, without a `reconstructed` entry — fm-01
`rollback_trigger` as a sentence ("if it gets worse") instead of metric + threshold + window + rollback — fm-02
`options_considered` with one item, or with no "do nothing / keep observing" item — fm-03
`blast_radius` with no number ("some EU users") — fm-04
a dashboard `evidence[]` URL with no pinned time range, or evidence consisting only of documentation pages — fm-05
`owner` equal to the `executor` entry with no delegation recorded, or a team / channel handle — fm-06
`decision` containing "consider", "maybe", "look into" or "should probably", or more than one sentence — r-decision-is-one-imperative-sentence

list.item: `committed_at` is within 2 minutes of `decided_at` and the bridge was open; otherwise a `reconstructed` entry with its time is present (r-record-before-bridge-closes).
`options_considered` lists at least two one-line options and one of them is do nothing / keep observing (r-options-considered-min-two).
`blast_radius` names systems, regions or tenants and carries a number (r-blast-radius-quantified).
`rollback_trigger` has metric, numeric threshold, time window and the rollback command or runbook URL (r-rollback-trigger-measurable).
`decision` is one imperative sentence with action, target and when; no hedging words (r-decision-is-one-imperative-sentence).
`owner` is the commander or recorded delegate; the executor, if different, is an `executor` entry (r-owner-is-commander-or-delegate).
Every dashboard URL has a pinned time range; at least one URL shows the system at the moment of the decision (r-evidence-is-timestamped-signal).
`review.next_review_at` is on or before `review.postmortem_date`; `outcome` is filled at the postmortem (r-review-at-postmortem).
